actorName: Lebanese Armed Forces / Lebanon Mine Action Center (LAF / LMAC)
tracedAction: Represents the Lebanese Armed Forces and Lebanon Mine Action Center layer for safety and access in affected areas. The practical role concerns safety screening, access control and risk reduction around affected locations. 10,000 troops deployed to South Lebanon under the ceasefire; CIMIC units interfaced with municipalities; the most trusted public institution and the vehicle for re-extending state authority.
tracedActionAr: يمثّل طبقة الجيش اللبناني والمركز اللبناني للأعمال المتعلقة بالألغام في ما يخص السلامة والوصول في المناطق المتضرّرة. ويتعلق الدور العملي بفحص السلامة وضبط الوصول وخفض المخاطر حول المواقع المتضرّرة. انتشار 10,000 جندي في جنوب لبنان بموجب وقف إطلاق النار؛ وحدات التعاون المدني - العسكري (CIMIC) على تواصل مع البلديات؛ المؤسسة العامة الأكثر حظوة بالثقة وأداة إعادة بسط سلطة الدولة.
summary:
Represents the Lebanese Armed Forces and Lebanon Mine Action Center layer for safety and access in affected areas. The practical role concerns safety screening, access control and risk reduction around affected locations.

10,000 troops deployed to South Lebanon under the ceasefire; CIMIC units interfaced with municipalities; the most trusted public institution and the vehicle for re-extending state authority.
summaryAr:
